question: Let \(A\) be the set of all points \((h,k)\) such that the area of the triangle formed by \((h,k)\), \((5,6)\) and \((3,2)\) is 12 square units. What is the least possible length of a line segment joining \((0,0)\) to a point in \(A\)?

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
